summary: First end-to-end test run for ChurnGuard MVP. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passing (health, auth login/register/logout/me, dashboard KPIs, organization, offers CRUD, analytics sessions, public cancel session init/respond/apply-offer for discount, pause, cancel, invalid api_key, invalid action). Frontend: All critical flows verified via Playwright — vendor login -> dashboard with KPI cards + MRR trend chart + reasons chart, offers manager (list seeded 4 offers, create modal, edit, toggle active, delete), analytics sessions table with all/saved/canceled filters, logout redirects to /login, and public cancellation wizard end-to-end for discount accept (50% off), pause accept, and decline -> goodbye states, plus invalid api_key error state. Stripe subscription mutations correctly return simulated:true with SIMULATED messages as designed for sk_test_emergent proxy.

issues: When AuthContext runs on public cancel page it hits /api/auth/me and logs 401 in console (harmless but noisy).

action_items: Optional: guard AuthContext /api/auth/me fetch so it does not fire on public routes (/cancel, /login) to remove harmless 401 console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_service.py cleanly labels SIMULATION fallback (simulated:true) as intended for sk_test_emergent proxy — good.
session_routes.session_init auto-creates ephemeral customer when external_user_id is unknown — acceptable but consider stronger validation for production.

dashboard_routes.update_offer: when `active` is set to False via PATCH, the `{k: v for k, v in ... if v is not None}` filter still lets False through only because False is not None — verified correct.
auth_routes lockout stored per IP+email — reasonable; note MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 with 15-min lockout could interfere with automated retest suites if tests fail repeatedly.
CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with credentials cookies (samesite=none) — works because same-origin proxy is used; if ever split hosts, explicit origin allowlist will be required.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data (Acme Analytics org, 4 offers, 5 customers ext_1001-1005, 40 historical sessions). Playwright test created & deleted one transient 'UI TEST' offer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/test_churnguard.py is the regression suite (run: pytest backend/tests/ -v). It covers auth, dashboard KPIs, offers CRUD, and public session end-to-end (discount/pause/cancel) with simulated Stripe assertions. Test emails must use RFC-valid domains (avoid .test/.example TLDs that pydantic EmailStr rejects — use @example.com).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; all specified features are working.
